decisions.generous-native-reading: Generous native reading under docs/project/divergences.md: grammar spelling, aliases, whitespace, compact statements or retained literal text. Canonical export and scoped native round-trip meaning are checked independently; upstream rejection alone is not a defect.
decisions.class-empty-label: Explicit empty Class label changes to the class ID after serialization and native reload.
decisions.diagnosed-source-preservation: Source preservation with an explicit source diagnostic and refusal of typed edits; no portable export is promised.
decisions.portable-label-token: Canonical writer emits a token rejected by the pinned grammar.
decisions.native-admission-disagreement: Typed admission succeeds without a source finding, but direct native SVG rendering throws. Canonical repair does not make the original public rendering safe.
decisions.empty-class-label: #549: explicit empty Class labels retain native reading and source bytes. Pinned Mermaid requires a nonempty label token; typed authoring refuses the empty value instead of losing it.
decisions.quoted-backtick-quadrant-label: #550: a literal leading backtick cannot be quoted without entering the pinned Markdown lexer state. Quote-requiring values stay readable and diagnosed as source-only; bare writable backticks remain editable.
decisions.shielded-class-direction-text: #548: Class text writers escape the initial letter of greedy direction tokens before composing the statement; native label and member meaning survives.
